name: Monterey
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Monterey, CA 2026
seo_desc: Monterey Christmas events for kids in 2026: tree lightings on Cannery Row and Colton Hall, a lighted boat parade, Santa, ice skating and more.
lede: Monterey keeps Christmas on the water and in the old town, with tree lightings on Cannery Row and at Colton Hall, a lighted boat parade, a free Christmas on the Wharf and candlelit adobes.
celebrates: Monterey celebrates Christmas along its waterfront and in Old Monterey. The season opens with the Cannery Row tree lighting, where Santa arrives on a balcony above Steinbeck Plaza, and Santa's Toy Factory stays open on weekends. Christmas on the Wharf fills Old Fisherman's Wharf with lights, music and Santa visits, and the Monterey Peninsula Yacht Club sends decorated boats through the harbor for Brighten the Harbor. The historic adobes glow with luminarias for Christmas in the Adobes, the Colton Hall lawn hosts a community tree lighting, and families can skate at Custom House Plaza or walk through lights at the fairgrounds.
lastyear: Monterey's 2025 season followed the same calendar, going by this year's anniversary numbers: the Cannery Row tree lighting was the 31st annual, Christmas on the Wharf was the ninth and Christmas in the Adobes was the 41st. The community tree lighting on the Colton Hall lawn was held on a Friday evening from 5 to 6 pm, with carols, candles and cookies, according to the Monterey events calendar. The City of Monterey also ran its Donuts with Santa Photo Op at a fire station, and this year's flyer calls it the third annual.
facts: Old Fisherman's Wharf in Monterey is celebrating its 181st anniversary in 2026, according to Visit Monterey. Cannery Row's tree lighting is in its 32nd year, and Christmas in the Adobes is in its 42nd. Colton Hall, where the community tree lighting is held, stands at 570 Pacific Street. Ice Skating by the Bay sets up its seasonal rink at Custom House Plaza behind the Portola Hotel & Spa, and the city lists it as open daily from November 20 to January 3.
trains: Monterey does not have a Christmas train ride of its own on our list. The nearest thing to a holiday procession is the Brighten the Harbor lighted boat parade, where decorated boats glide past Old Fisherman's Wharf, and the weekend Santa's Toy Factory on Cannery Row. If your family is set on a train, our California guide to Christmas train rides lists rides around the state, and each host's site has the current dates and tickets.
traditions: Carolers, balloon artists and Santa's arrival on a balcony over Steinbeck Plaza, followed by Santa's Toy Factory.
A free celebration at Old Fisherman's Wharf with lights, music and Santa visits.
Brighten the Harbor Lighted Boat Parade
Decorated boats from the Monterey Peninsula Yacht Club glide through the harbor.
Historic adobes decorated for the season with candlelit luminarias, music and living history.
A community tree lighting on the Colton Hall lawn with carols and cookies.
A seasonal outdoor rink at Custom House Plaza in Old Monterey.
kidfact: At the Cannery Row tree lighting, Santa Claus arrives on the balcony overlooking Steinbeck Plaza, and afterward kids can meet him in his Toy Factory and take a free photo.
faq: When is the Monterey tree lighting in 2026?
The Cannery Row tree lighting is Friday, November 27, 2026, and the community tree lighting on the Colton Hall lawn is Friday, December 4, 2026, at 5 pm.
Is Christmas on the Wharf free?
Yes. Visit Monterey calls the 10th annual Christmas on the Wharf a free celebration at Old Fisherman's Wharf.
Where can kids meet Santa in Monterey?

Santa's Toy Factory on Cannery Row is open Saturdays and Sundays from November 28 to December 20, and Santa is also at Del Monte Center, at Donuts with Santa on December 5 and at Breakfast with Santa at Jacks Monterey.
Is there ice skating in Monterey?
Yes. Ice Skating by the Bay is an outdoor rink at Custom House Plaza behind the Portola Hotel & Spa, and the City of Monterey lists it as open November 20 to January 3.
Are there Christmas events near Monterey?
Yes. Pacific Grove, Carmel-by-the-Sea and Seaside are close by, and Pacific Grove and Seaside have their own guides on this site.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Monterey for 2026, and here is what he found: 13 family events, 7 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (the Cannery Row tree lighting) through January 3, 2027 (the last day of Ice Skating by the Bay), with Donuts with Santa Photo Op (December 5), Brighten the Harbor Lighted Boat Parade (December 6) and Christmas in the Adobes (December 11 and 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Monterey

  • 13 Christmas events for kids in Monterey
  • 7 free events, including the Cannery Row tree lighting, Christmas on the Wharf and the Brighten the Harbor Lighted Boat Parade
  • Meet Santa: Santa's Toy Factory on Cannery Row (Saturdays and Sundays, November 28 to December 20), Donuts with Santa Photo Op (December 5), Breakfast with Santa at Jacks Monterey (November 29 and December 6) and Photos with Santa at Del Monte Center (through December 23)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the lighted boat parade (December 6), the Cannery Row tree lighting (November 27) and the Colton Hall tree lighting (December 4)
  • Lights and skating: Winter Wonderfest at the Monterey County Fairgrounds and Ice Skating by the Bay at Custom House Plaza
  • Old Monterey evenings: Christmas in the Adobes (December 11 and 12) and Old Town Monterey Navidad at Cooper-Molera Adobe (December 15)
  • Season: November 27 to January 3, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Monterey families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Salinas, which covers the Salinas Valley and Monterey County nearby.
